CHINESE TAX BUREAU FUNCTIONING ON JESSFIELD ROAD, O.O.L.

At 8.10p.m. 1.11.37 the undersigned was ordered to
interview Maj.K.M.Bourne D.C.(Sp.Br.) at his home on the
above subject.

Maj.K.M.Bourne stated that a servant employed by Mr.
A.T.Seddon, residing at Lane 125/12 Kinnear Road, had been

Chinese Tax Bureau officer who had seized a quantity of
cigarettes for non-payment of tax. A receipt for the
seized cigarettes had been issued from Nantao and was to

returned. The receipt was handed to the undersigned who
was instructed to make further enquiries.

Proceedings:-        Judge to Appellant:- Were you convicted before ?
                     A. No.
                     Q. Were you an inspector of the Education Bureau ?
                     A. Yes, formerly I also ran a primary school.
                     Q. What is the reason for your appeal ?
                     A. As working for the education of those illiterate
labourers in the 9th Division under the order of the Education
Bureau, I had to make enquiries about the concerns which failed
to register with the Educational Authorities. When I went to
the Compt. the first time, she told me that her concern did fail
to take the necessary steps to educate the employees as required.
I gave her a little warning saying that an examination would be
taken on her employees at 4p.m. At 4p.m. 26/5/37 I again
advised the Compt. to open a class for her illiterate employees.
                     Q. You need not say too much about how you made
enquiries about the Compt's concern.
                     A. Yes, on 28/5/37 the Compt. told me that she
still had not engaged a teacher to open the class. I then said
to her that, if she pleases, the Education Bureau could secure a

JUDGMENT

The above named accused was charged from West
Hongkew Police Station with committing an offence of
fraud by taking advantage of an opportunity afforded
him by his official functions, and the case is hereby
decided by this Court as follows:-

TEXT

Dsung Li Ching sentenced to six months' imprisonment
for attempting to cause another by fraudulent means to
deliver something by taking advantage of an opportunity
afforded him by his official functions and deprived of
civil rights for one year.

of time more than 10 female workers were unable to parti-
cipate in the examination. Dsung Li Ching accordingly
utilised the opportunity thus afforded to commit an offence
of fraud. On the one hand he submitted to the Social Affairs
Bureau a report on the number of persons who passed or
failed in the examination and concealed everything from

his report in regard to the other illiterate workers who
did not participate in the examination. On the other
he spoke to the proprietress of the said book-binding
shop, Zung Zee Sz: "Those workers who failed and did
not participate in the examination must be sent to
school and taught to read for four months. The total
amount of fees shall be $80 and the money is to be paid
at a fixed date." Upon hearing this Zung Zee Sz was
much surprised. She asked someone else to make enquiries
at the Social Affairs Bureau and found out that it was a
case of fraud. On the 28th of the same month the Social
Affairs Bureau dispatched its officer Sze Vee Chung,
and accompanied by Sih Shih Ling, a member of the Detective
Corps of the Police Bureau, he proceeded to the West Hongkew
Police Station and asked for assistance. Then they proceeded
together to the Zung Sih Kee Book-binding Shop, and as they
were aware that Dzung Li Ching was coming to collect the
money, they concealed themselves in a room. Dzung Li Ching
arrived at the time fixed. Thereupon Zung Zee Sz handed
to him $15 in notes which bore special marks. He did
not issue a receipt after he had received the money. No
sooner than he was leaving the house he was arrested by
detectives and charged accordingly.

REASONS

Not only has the complainant Zung Zee Sz made a
statement in detail in regard to the above mentioned facts,
Sze Vee Chung, an officer of the Social Affairs Bureau,
Sih Shih Ling, a member of the Detective Corps of the Police
Bureau, and C.D.C. 396 have also corroborated in their
statements in regard to the circumstances under which the
accused was arrested. Furthermore there were specially-marked
bank notes for $15 seized. The evidence against the accused
page_data.zh:
-2-
会局提交了关于考试通过或未通过人数的报告，并对其他未参加考试的文盲工人的情况隐瞒不报。另一方面，他对上述装订店的老板娘曾子氏（Zung Zee Sz，音译）说：“那些考试不及格和未参加考试的工人必须送去学校，接受四个月的识字教育。费用总额为80美元，钱款需在指定日期支付。”曾子氏（Zung Zee Sz，音译）听后大为惊讶。她派人向社会局查询，发现这是一起诈骗案。同月28日，社会局派遣官员施维中（Sze Vee Chung，音译），并由警察局侦探队成员施士林（Sih Shih Ling，音译）陪同，前往虹口西区警察局请求协助。随后他们一同前往宗义记（Zung Sih Kee，音译）装订店，由于他们得知董立清（Dzung Li Ching，音译）要来收钱，便躲在一个房间里。董立清（Dzung Li Ching，音译）在预定时间到达。随即，曾子氏（Zung Zee Sz，音译）将带有特殊标记的15美元纸币交给他。他收到钱后未开具收据。他刚离开房子，就被侦探逮捕并被相应起诉。

理由

不仅投诉人曾子氏（Zung Zee Sz，音译）就上述事实作了详细陈述，社会局官员施维中（Sze Vee Chung，音译）、警察局侦探队成员施士林（Sih Shih Ling，音译）以及C.D.C. 396也在其陈述中证实了被告被捕时的情形。此外，还查获了带有特殊标记的15美元纸币。针对被告的证据

page_data.en:
-3-
is therefor clear and definite. The accused contends:
"I merely said those who failed in the examination must
be educated and can be sent to the Characters-Learning
School attached to the Jing Yih Primary School for Girls.
The tuition per month is $15 and the fee charged for
books is $5, thus making a total of $80 for four months.
The $15 which the complainant handed to me was to be
used for engaging a teacher." This forms the basis on
which he contends that there has been no fraudulent intent
on his part. Article 11 of "What Ought to Know in regard
to Establishment of Labourers' Characters-Learning Schools
by Factories, Workshops, Companies, or Shops" published
by the Social Affairs Bureau, provides: "The period of
training in a Labourers' Characters-Learning School shall
be three months. Under special circumstances the period
may, with the approval of the Social Affairs Bureau, be
shortened or extended." Article 14 provides: "In the
case of a Labourers' Characters-Learning School with 100
students divided into two classes, the monthly ordinary
expenses shall be (1) $15 as salary for a teacher and (2)
$5 as charge for students' stationery (5 cents per head
per month, which will make up this amount with 100 students
in two classes)". Article 8 of the Revised Measures for
the Enforcement of the Labourers' Characters-Learning
Education in the Municipality of Greater Shanghai provides:
"Where the number of illiterate workers in a factory,
workshop, company or shop within the areas of this Munici-
pality is up to 30, a Labourers' Characters-Learning
School shall be established by the said factory, workshop,
company or shop." Among the workers employed by the
Tung Sih Kue Shop, only one failed to pass the examination,
page_data.zh:
-3-
因此清晰明确。被告辩称：“我只是说那些考试不及格的人必须接受教育，可以送到景义女子小学附属的识字学校去学习。每月学费15美元，书本费5美元，因此四个月总共80美元。投诉人交给我的15美元是用来聘请老师的。”这构成了他声称自己没有欺诈意图的基础。社会局发布的《工厂、作坊、公司或商店设立劳工识字学校须知》第十一条规定：“劳工识字学校的培训期为三个月。在特殊情况下，经社会局批准，期限可以缩短或延长。”第十四条规定：“对于拥有100名学生、分为两个班的劳工识字学校，每月的常规开支应为 (1) 教师薪金15美元，以及 (2) 学生文具费5美元（每人每月5美分，两个班100名学生即凑成此数额）。”《大上海市实施劳工识字教育修正办法》第八条规定：“在本市区域内，凡工厂、作坊、公司或商店的文盲工人人数达到30人者，应由该工厂、作坊、公司或商店设立劳工识字学校。”在宗义记（Tung Sih Kue，音译）店雇佣的工人中，只有一人未通过考试，

page_data.en:
-4-

and the number of those who did not participate in
the examination is only ten or more. Even if they are
all regarded as illiterate and should be taught to
learn characters, yet as the number of persons is not
up to 30 there is no necessity for establishing a school
independently. For a Labourers' Characters-Learning School
with 100 students in two classes, the salary of a teacher
is not more than $15 per month and the stationery charge
to be paid by each student is not more than five cents
per month. As the accused insisted that the other ten or
more illiterate workers in the Zung Sih Kee shop should be
sent to the school in the neighbourhood, then why he
should have said that the monthly tuition was $15 and the
book fees $5. The period of training in a Labourers'
Characters-Learning School is, as a principle, three months.
Before the Social Affairs Bureau agreed to the extension
of the period, the accused declared that the period was
four months at a cost of $80. Then who would believe that
there was no fraudulent intent on his part? The expenses
in connection with the education of workers are, as a rule,
to be defrayed directly by the employers. The accused is
an Inspector and is working in a directing capacity. He
should report to the Social Affairs Bureau the result of
his investigation or any of his opinions. He is not
empowered to collect any money. However, by taking advantage
of the opportunity afforded him by his functions of inves-
tigation and examination, he obtained money by fraudulent
means from Zung Zee Sz without issuing a receipt on the
one hand and failed to report on the number of illiterate
workers in the Zung Sih Kee Shop on the other (Vide report
submitted by accused to the Social Affairs Bureau). It is
quite apparent under the circumstances that he obtained
the money unlawfully with intent to appropriate same for
page_data.zh:
-4-

而未参加考试的人数仅为十多人。即使将他们全部视为文盲并应教其识字，但由于人数未达到30人，没有必要独立设立学校。对于拥有100名学生、分为两个班的劳工识字学校，教师的月薪不超过15美元，每位学生支付的文具费每月不超过5美分。既然被告坚持要求宗义记（Zung Sih Kee，音译）店的其他十多名文盲工人去附近的学校上学，那他为何又说每月学费15美元，书本费5美元呢？劳工识字学校的培训期原则上为三个月。在社会局同意延长期限之前，被告宣称期限为四个月，费用为80美元。那么谁会相信他没有欺诈意图呢？工人教育的相关费用，通常由雇主直接支付。被告是一名视察员，从事指导工作。他应将调查结果或任何意见报告给社会局。他无权收取任何钱款。然而，他利用调查和考试职务之便，一方面从曾子氏（Zung Zee Sz，音译）处通过欺诈手段获取钱款且未开具收据，另一方面未报告宗义记（Zung Sih Kee，音译）店文盲工人的数量（参见被告向社会局提交的报告）。在这种情况下，很明显他是非法获取这笔钱款，意图将其据为己

himself. He contends that he was going to engage a teacher
on the complainant's behalf. This is mere excuse and
unacceptable. A consummated offence of fraud as provided
in the Criminal Code is deemed to be established only
when, besides the fact that the offender commits a fraudulent
act with intent to obtain something unlawfully, the injured
party has had some wrong conception due to such act, with the
result that he disposes of his property (vide the Highest Court
decisions, Character Shang, No.1699, 18th year and Character
Shang, No.3064, 23rd year). The complainant Zung Zee Sz
in this case, after having made enquiries from the Social
Affairs Bureau, became aware that it was a fraudulent act
on the part of the accused. Furthermore she made preparations
and put special marks on the bank notes delivered. Again,
it was after a joint consultation by members of the Social
Affairs Bureau, the Police Bureau and the Settlement Police
that the money was paid. This was only a method of procuring
evidence. There should be no doubt that the complainant
has not had any wrong conception. In accordance with the
above explanation the accused can only be deemed to have
committed an offence of attempted fraud. It seems improper
for the Police to charge him with extortion, and this Court
should therefore change the article used by the Police. The
accused was a public officer and, by taking advantage of
the opportunity afforded him by his official functions,
committed an offence of fraud. His punishment should there-
fore be increased by one-half. As the injury results from
the commission is slight, the punishment to be meted out
should not be too severe.

1936年10月6日下午4时，一辆牌照号为15158的中国公共汽车公司巴士，由266号司机杨岳龙（Yang Yue Loong，音译）驾驶，沿布伦南路（Brenan Road，即今南京西路）由东向西行驶。当行驶至卢比孔路（Rubicon Road，即今西康路）以东约1,000码处时，撞倒并碾过一名突然从北向南横穿马路、跑至车前的5岁中国女童谢马珍（Tseu Mah Jung，音译）。巴士左前轮显然从其身体下部碾过，致其当场死亡。

该司机被英租界巡捕（B.P.S. Police）逮捕，并被带往北四川路捕房，随后尽管工部局警务处（S.M.P.）提出交涉，仍被移交给华界当局。
